unwired_by_decision.checkpoint_gate_check.py: ROTTED, not merely unwired (vibe-ic#693). It runs without crashing but addresses a directory layout the flow abandoned. MEASURED over the 46 run trees on a working checkout: 46/46 FAIL at checkpoint 1, 46/46 at checkpoint 2, 46/46 at checkpoint 3 - 100 percent, and every red is path rot, not a defect. On one real DRC-clean Phase-3 run (9050 measured shapes in the layout it consumed) CP1 reports 8 MISSING of 9 because phase1_spec/01_prompt.md..05_appnote.md do not exist - the run uses phase1/generated_docs/ - and only l_layer_docs PASSes. CP2 reports 5 MISSING + 1 FAIL of 12 including two ACTIVE MIS-READS: the required-file glob for RTL resolves to the FORMAL file ([PASS] file:rtl -> phase2/stage1/formal/formal_spm.sv, a false MATCH rather than a false miss), and cell_count reports 0 cell(s) on a run that placed real cells. No insertion point exists either: grep -c checkpoint over flow/phase1_phase2_phase3.yaml is 0 - the flow has no checkpoint concept, only per-step gates. Its substance is already covered: CP1 L-doc presence by phase1_doc_presence_check (the one sub-check that passes), CP2 synth/DEF/GDS/DRC by flow steps 14/16/31/37 (gds_substance_check, drc_report_check, provenance_check), CP3 FPGA sign-off by step 37 plus the FPGA cap-gap waiver machinery. Wiring it in ANY form, blocking or reporting, is an outage that trains readers to ignore it. The repair is to rewrite the checklist against the current layout or delete the program - not to wire it. Tracked as the checkpoint-gate SKILL rot noted in skills/checkpoint-gate/SKILL.md.
